name: One Way Ticket ~Fushigi na Katamichi Kippu~
original_name: One Way Ticket ～不思議な片道切符～
source:
Hero mistakenly receives a one way ticket. Train takes him to a strange world. When train goes uphill hero finds himself in embrace of maid girls with cat ears and when going downhill - under special care of nurses.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄错误地收到了一张单程票。火车带他到了一个陌生的世界。当火车上坡时，英雄发现自己被长着猫耳朵的女仆拥抱着，而当火车下坡时，他又受到了护士的特殊照顾。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
